description: This reproduction package combines Belgian gas-network data with Julia code for emission-constrained planning and input-convex neural-network training. Separate folders address operating and long-term planning. The provider is Vladimir Dvorkin; Samuel Chevalier; Spyros Chatzivasileiadis. Coverage: The example is a Belgian gas network. The deposit accompanies a 2023 paper; operating periods, spatial detail and network size are not stated in its abstract. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The code uses JuMP and Flux with specified Julia environments. Approximation accuracy, constraints and reproducibility were not tested. For simulation it supports reproducing emission-constrained optimisation and comparing learned network approximations. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
